hypothesis_change_reason: Dispatch 130 changed its diagnosis to 'the delta is unattested core WIP, do not release it'. It then inherited dispatch 128's remedy as correct-in-principle: quiesce the core, commit/tag the WIP, re-materialize. This dispatch tested that remedy's convergence property instead of re-measuring the core. Convergence is false and the failure is structural, not a matter of the core not yet having been committed. Consequently dispatch 130's own routing conclusion is not the operative fact; the operative fact is that the guard's core identity is a digest of the core's LIVE WORKING TREE, so parity is not a state any project can ever be pinned to.

NOR the core's current live tree (3a5e7e3d88030fee5...). The pinned identity existed only as a live observation of a moving tree at 2026-09-27T18:01:03Z and is now unreproducible by construction.

narrative.HYPOTHESIS: If dispatch 130's remedy were sound, then committing the core's WIP and re-materializing would converge - i.e. the resulting project state would be stable and the guard would go green. The remedy's convergence rests on the pinned core identity being an addressable, reproducible state. Measured: core_digest is computed over uncommitted working-tree bytes, so the pinned identity is not addressable, is not reproducible by any commit, and moves every time the core's own program edits its canonical sources. Therefore re-materialization cannot converge to any fixed point: each materialization pins a fresh digest that the core's next WIP edit invalidates. The mismatch count already grew 18 -> 30 inside one repair dispatch, which is that non-convergence observed directly.
narrative.CHANGE: Measurement only. No repository file, no core file, no manifest, no lock and no lifecycle file was written in D:\Projeler\hpc-client-gui or in D:\Projeler\.agents-core. New paths from this dispatch: this artifact and .tmp/w57repair131/**.
narrative.RESULT: Hypothesis confirmed. The blocker is a single, named, repository-owned technical defect in a different repository: materialization_guard.core_digest() derives the core's identity from a live working tree instead of from a committed ref, so a project can never be pinned to a reproducible core state. That defect is upstream of every remedy attempted in dispatches 124-130 and is not repairable from W57, which is additionally forbidden by its own report from materializing. Observed twice, independently, inside this one dispatch: the project-side mismatch count grew 18 -> 30, and the core's dirty canonical path count grew 40 -> 55 -> 69 with a new canonical file (setup/materialize-ac-core.py) entering the digest's input set. W57's own product/evidence surface is healthy: focused retest 17/17, orchestration 61/61, candidate identity intact. The sole W57-owned red is FREEZE-030/-040 on DEF-W57-006, genuine unavailable external authority. BLOCKED is returned on the one proven prerequisite, replacing a REOPEN that has now been returned three times with the same unaddressable owner.
